text: Estimation is inference. Knowledge that arises from consultation is estimation. Knowledge that is distinguished by its pervasive, characteristic aspect is consultation. For example, the knowledge that “the mountain is covered with ash” is a result of consultation. The inference that “the mountain is covered with ash” is knowledge by estimation. Wherever there is ash, there is fire; this is the rule of association, and the pervasiveness of ash over the mountain expresses the characteristic nature of the side (aspect).
